notes: Cleaner price scale, working re-test counts, and more reliable zone tracking.
changelog: The zone count values no longer stretch the price scale or show on the price axis. Re-add the indicator to an existing chart to pick this up.
Re-test zones now count each re-test even when Success Rate Tracking is off.
At the zone limit, a hot bar that cannot form a zone no longer removes your oldest zone.
In Keep Both re-test mode, a broken zone is now removed when there is no room for its re-test zone.
Zone counts for strategies no longer include a zone broken on the current bar.
